title: Coffe Monsters
tagline: Hey there, caffeine junkies and crypto enthusiasts! Buckle up, because we're about to launch the most exhilarating event of the year on the Starknet blockchain: "Coffee Crisis" Forget your usual coffee run; this is where the real buzz is at!
description:
What's Brewing?

In "Coffee Crisis," your love for coffee isn't just a morning ritual; it's the heart of the action. The game is simple: the more asset coins you have in the Starknet, the more Coffee coins you get. But here's the kicker – your very own coffee-loving monster can't get enough of them, and its appetite only grows bigger every day. 

Your holdings determine your daily dose of Coffee coins. The more you've got, the more you get. But beware, it's not just about holding onto them; it's about strategic brewing! 

Every day, your monster demands more Coffee coins than the day before. Their cravings know no bounds, and it's up to you to keep up. Miss a beat, and you might find yourself in a decaffeinated dilemma. 

Here's the twist – your stash of Coffee coins dwindles daily. Yes, you heard right. Each day, the number of Coffee coins you have decreases, making it a race against time to satisfy your monster's ever-growing demands. 

Let the Games Begin!
how_its_made:
In the realm of blockchain innovation, the "Coffee Monsters - Coffee Crisis" project emerges as a pioneering venture, leveraging the cutting-edge technologies of Madara and Avail, alongside the Giza platform's capabilities. This project aims to address a niche yet significant challenge in the blockchain ecosystem: creating a blockchain-based game that operates with a unique economic model, where the native currency for all transactions is Coffee tokens. This initiative not only showcases the potential for specialized application chains but also demonstrates the feasibility of custom fee tokens and micro-payments in a gaming context.

Building the Blockchain with Madara and Avail

At the heart of our project lies the creation of an application-specific blockchain, utilizing the frameworks provided by Madara and Avail. These technologies enable us to construct a blockchain network tailored to the needs of our game, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and a high degree of customization. The choice of Coffee as the native currency for transaction fees is a strategic response to the challenge of creating custom fee tokens, which is not efficiently addressable by deploying smart contracts on general-purpose chains.

Madara provides the foundational layer for building our blockchain, offering the tools necessary for defining the game's logic, transactions, and consensus mechanism. Avail, on the other hand, enhances our network's scalability and data integrity by serving as a decentralized data availability layer. This integration ensures that our blockchain is not only robust and secure but also capable of supporting the unique demands of the "Coffee Monsters" game.

Coffee Monsters - Coffee Crisis: The Game

"Coffee Crisis" is an exhilarating blockchain event where the worlds of crypto and caffeine collide. Players manage their Coffee coins to fuel their coffee-loving monsters, navigating through daily challenges and strategizing to keep the buzz alive. This game represents a unique adventure in the blockchain space, combining the thrill of gaming with the intricacies of cryptocurrency economics.

The economic model of the game is ingeniously designed around the Coffee tokens. These tokens are not just a currency within the game but also serve as the medium for all transaction fees on the blockchain. This approach not only makes the gaming experience more immersive but also introduces players to the concept of blockchain economics in a fun and engaging way.

Integration with Giza

To further enhance the gaming experience, we plan to integrate verifiable neural networks using Giza Actions. This integration will allow us to build and scale machine learning solutions that are reliable, scalable, and easy to trust. By turning our Python scripts and ML models into resilient, recurrent workflows, we can introduce complex AI-driven events and challenges within the game, making "Coffee Crisis Part 1" not just a game but a showcase of blockchain and AI integration.

Conclusion

The "Coffee Monsters - Coffee Crisis" project is more than just a game; it's a testament to the potential of blockchain technology to create unique, engaging experiences that go beyond traditional gaming. By leveraging the technologies of Madara, Avail, and Giza, we are not only addressing a specific problem in the blockchain space but also paving the way for future innovations in blockchain gaming and economics. Our team, comprising seasoned professionals in project management, design, and development, is excited to bring this vision to life and share the adventure of "Coffee Crisis" with the world.
